title: We've had a positive experience with...
review:
We've had a positive experience with Nextiva overall. The phone system is reliable, easy to use, and offers great features for managing calls and improving communication across our team. The call quality is consistently good, and the mobile app makes it convenient to stay connected while away from the office.

Customer support has also been helpful whenever we've needed assistance. The only reason I'm giving 4 stars instead of 5 is that some features can be a bit complex to set up initially, and occasional system updates may require a learning curve.

Overall, Nextiva is a solid business communication solution that provides excellent value and dependable service. I would recommend it to businesses looking for a professional and scalable phone system.

title: Our three stores Greenville TX, Sherman...

title: We've had an overall positive...
review:
We've had an overall positive experience with Nextiva. Call quality and reliability have been good, and the platform provides most of the features we need to manage phones across our organization. Features like call groups, forwarding, business-hour routing, delegation, and centralized administration give us quite a bit of flexibility.

Deployment and provisioning are generally straightforward, especially with supported desk phones, although some of the more advanced configuration options can be difficult to find or aren't as intuitive as they could be. A lot of phone specific features are locked behind Support-Only tools. The self-provisioning of devices is nice. We have a lot of different locations and being able to simply ship a phone to a user and have it be virtually plug-and-play is very convenient.

Support has been a mixed experience. They're generally able to help resolve problems, but more unusual issues can sometimes require additional troubleshooting or escalation before reaching a solution.

Pricing is reasonable considering the number of features included, although it can become fairly significant as the number of users and devices grows.

Overall, Nextiva has been a reliable business phone system for us. There are areas where the administration and support experience could be improved, but the reliability and feature set have made it a good fit for our organization.
